newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia crude oil output seen up over 3 yrs.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia crude oil output seen up over 3 yrs.

text.p: Crude oil production in Australia is expected to rise over the next three years at rates of up to 15 percent annually before going into decline at about the same rate, the government's chief forecaster said on Tuesday.

Condensate production is expected to increase up to 2001/02 (July-June) in association with 12 percent a year growth in natural gas output, the Australian Bureau of Agricutural and Resource Economics (ABARE) said in a paper for delivery later on Tuesday at a conference.
Based on 50 percent probability, ABARE estimates Australia's total crude oil and condensate production in 1999/2000 at 650,000 barrels a day.
By 2001/02, production is forecast to decline to around 550,000 barrels.
World crude oil prices should average about US$19 a barrel to 2001/02, ABARE said.
